Oncology Service
Enhancing Quality of Life Through Collaborative Oncology Care
Support your patients and clients with compassionate, expert-driven treatment plans.
Register for a Free Account
Submit a Consult Now
Personalized, Evidence-Based Oncology Teleconsultations
You’re the first to face the questions with a new cancer diagnosis.
Clients look to you for clarity, compassion, and a plan.
Whether you're managing the case in-house or referral isn't feasible, DVM STAT connects you with board-certified oncologists who provide personalized, evidence-based guidance - so you can offer real hope and improve quality of life, step by step.
You deserve trusted guidance that helps you provide excellent oncology care.
Expert Oncology Guidance at Your Fingertips
At DVM STAT, we understand the emotional and financial toll that comes with a cancer diagnosis.  That’s why our board-certified oncologists focus on providing evidence-based and client-goal centered treatment plans.
We’re here to help you:
Improve patient quality of life & outcomes
Reduce emotional and medical guesswork
Strengthen client confidence
in your recommendations
Deliver
compassionate, modern oncology care
— even when specialty referral is not possible
What You Receive With Every Oncology Consult
Detailed Case Review
You’ll receive a comprehensive written report tailored to your patient, including interpretation of clinical findings, differentials, staging recommendations, and specific next steps.
Therapeutic Guidance
We help you evaluate treatment options, including oral or injectable chemotherapy, targeted therapies, and non-invasive alternatives — tailored to your clinic’s resources and the client’s goals.
Collaborative Care Model
Our approach supports the triad of care:
veterinarian, client, and patient.
We work as an extension of your team, helping you provide advanced insight while maintaining the client relationship you’ve built.
Quality of Life First
Treatment isn’t always about cure. Our oncologists prioritize comfort, longevity, and the patient’s well-being above all else — helping you recognize when to treat, when to pause, and when to focus on palliative care.
Client Communication Support
Discussing cancer with owners can be emotionally charged. We help you frame treatment options clearly, set expectations, and explain side effects in a way that builds trust and transparency.
True Case Co-Management with Specialists Who Care
Our oncology consultants help you manage cancer cases confidently- without losing the connection you’ve built with your clients.
How it Works
Submit Your Case Online
– Include patient history, diagnostics, images, and your clinical questions
Receive a Detailed Consult
– Within hours, get a custom treatment and staging plan from our oncology team
Continue the Conversation
– Our specialists are available for follow-up questions and ongoing case support
What to Expect from an Oncology Report
More Than a Treatment Plan — A Comprehensive, Compassionate Guide
What Oncology Case Co-Management Looks Like
You manage cancer cases with confidence and clarity.
Your clients feel informed, supported—and stay with your practice.
Your patients receive compassionate, coordinated care.
You strengthen your bond with both the client and patient.
You make treatment decisions backed by evidence and expertise.
When Referral Isn’t an Option
Long wait times, financial barriers, or geographic limitations often leave you as the primary—and only—provider for pets with cancer. Without support, critical treatment windows can be missed.
What’s Possible With DVM STAT Oncology
Every cancer case is unique - and you don’t have to manage it alone. Our board-certified oncologists provide personalized, evidence-based guidance to help you interpret diagnostics, evaluate options, and move forward with confidence, whether you're treating in-house or awaiting referral.
We support you with:
Diagnosed or suspected neoplasia
Treatment planning: stage, monitor, treat, or palliate
Non-surgical cases or when surgery isn’t an option
Medical management and owner-friendly communication
Real-time support when referral is delayed or unavailable
With DVM STAT, you can:
Offer more treatment options, earlier
Keep specialist-level care in-house
Build stronger client trust and continuity
Reduce stress with expert support behind every decision
Faster, evidence-based treatment decisions guided by oncology experts.
Ready to Get Started?
Whether you’re managing cancer cases in-house or preparing for specialty referral, DVM STAT Oncology offers fast, collaborative support you can trust.
